questions.question: A relation R on a set A is called reflexive if:

options.A: (a, a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A
options.C: (a, b) ∈ R and (b, c) ∈ R imply (a, c) ∈ R
options.D: (a, b) ∉ R for all a, b

questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): '(a, a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A'. In FBISE Grade 9 Mathematics Unit 3 (Sets & Relations), this is the standard mathematical definition, theorem, or computational property examined by the Federal Board.

questions.question: A relation is symmetric if:

options.B: (a, b) ∈ R and (b, c) ∈ R imply (a, c) ∈ R
options.C: (a, a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A
options.D: (a, b) ∉ R for all a, b

questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): '(a, b) ∈ R implies (b, a) ∈ R'. In FBISE Grade 9 Mathematics Unit 3 (Sets & Relations), this is the standard mathematical definition, theorem, or computational property examined by the Federal Board.

questions.question: A transitive relation satisfies:

options.A: If (a, b) ∈ R and (b, c) ∈ R, then (a, c) ∈ R
options.B: If (a, b) ∈ R, then (b, a) ∈ R
options.C: (a, a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A
options.D: (a, b) ∉ R for all a, b

questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): 'If (a, b) ∈ R and (b, c) ∈ R, then (a, c) ∈ R'. In FBISE Grade 9 Mathematics Unit 3 (Sets & Relations), this is the standard mathematical definition, theorem, or computational property examined by the Federal Board.
